Needs a green heavy run before merge.

The trial merge with upstream/main `ee91ac3e5` is clean. This review used the current upstream AGENTS.md.
All builds and tests ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3032`. No GitHub runner was used.

What looks good:
- All 22 adaptive tests remain. The existing ignored marker remains.
- All 61 original assertion lines remain. The only added assertion sets the 90-second budget.
- The moved helpers use public motion APIs. The decision file explains the fixture choices.
- No production geometry, G-code, collision check, stock simulation, UI, dependency, or golden file changes.
- The parallel target passed in 40.39 seconds. The island target passed in 107.79 seconds. The neck target passed in 110.83 seconds.

Results:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS, 178 steps, zero failures, 1,884 test passes, 71 ignored tests, 25.1 minutes.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: FAIL, 237 steps, one failure, 97 test passes outside the expected-failure checks, 35.5 minutes. This review ran every reached lane.
- The moved L-shape test passed in the release heavy run with the D/80 grid.
- The marked known-fail cases failed at their expected assertions. The gate accepted those results.
- The heavy run also ran the ignored light twins in the reached motion and app targets.

Extra suites run:
- No additional data-reader or importer suites were required. The diff changes no fixture data or import code.
- The shared fixture code is read by `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, and `adaptive_troch_parallel`. All three ran in quick and heavy.
- The failing bore test also ran alone on unmodified upstream/main and again on the trial merge. Both runs failed with the same counts.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:144` (Linux pin at line 191): resolve the reached release heavy failure before merge.
   `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` expects `(4726, 4698, 549)` on Linux x86_64.
   It reports `(3158, 3130, 1141)`. The earlier safety assertions pass.
   Unmodified upstream/main `ee91ac3e5` has the same failure. This PR does not introduce it.
   Resolve the baseline failure separately if needed. Then obtain a green run of `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm`.
   The current “Heavy lanes at review” law blocks readiness while a reached heavy test is red.

Failure excerpt:
```text
panicked at crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:144:5:
the bore's path as the fix plans it: (3158, 3130, 1141)
test result: FAILED. 0 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 2 filtered out
```

Mutations: not run. This test-only diff does not meet the safety-tier trigger. No goldens moved.
Windows, macOS, the full batch tier, and the full release tier were not exercised.
The island and neck debug tests still exceed the 60-second guideline. The issue explicitly permits a target split; both targets remain below its approximate 300-second goal on this machine.
The post-merge runner measurements remain unverified here.
